title: Spells, Stasis & Spray
description: A glowing magical shop door embedded in a rocky cliffside overlooking the ocean at dusk. The wooden door features swirling teal and green potion-like patterns with a bright central glow, surrounded by hanging lanterns, starfish, and a wooden sign reading 'Spells · Stasis · Spray' and 'Stasis & Spray - Spell Shop Slot 28'.
prompt: A magical wooden door with glowing teal and green swirling potion patterns set into a rocky cliff overlooking the sea at twilight. The door is framed by a large sign reading Spells Stasis Spray and Stasis & Spray Spell Shop Slot 28. Hanging lanterns, starfish, and a scroll with a swirl symbol rest nearby. A small chalkboard sign sits on the wet rocks below as ethereal light streams from the door and upper balcony, digital fantasy illustration, cinematic lighting
